title: Mipiti test-result attestation predicate (v1)
description: The predicate of an in-toto Statement with predicateType https://mipiti.io/attestations/test-result/v1. Produced by `mipiti-verify attest-tests`; any producer that emits a conforming statement signed under an identity the verifier is pinned to is accepted. Verification reads the statement and executes nothing.

commit.description: Git commit the run covered. Must equal the commit under verification; an empty value fails.

invocation.description: argv the producer's own test step executed, as recorded by the producer.

outcome.description: passed only when failed == 0, errors == 0 and passed > 0.

totals.description: Must be self-consistent: passed + failed + skipped + errors == total.

selected.description: How many tests the run selected. matched_count must be > 0; a vacuous selection is refused.

file.description: Optional. Repository-relative path of the file the test is defined in, as located in the checkout at attestation time.

definition_sha256.description: Optional. SHA-256 over the test's definition block (decorators through the end of the body; CRLF folded to LF, trailing whitespace stripped per line) when it could be isolated, otherwise over the whole file (see definition_scope). Absent when the test could not be located; absence is 'not resolved', never a match.

definition_scope.description: Optional. Present, as "file", when definition_sha256 covers the whole file because the test's own definition could not be isolated.

reached.description: Optional. Files and lines this test executed, from a coverage report with contexts (`attest-tests --coverage`). An empty array is a fact: the run had coverage and the test touched nothing tracked. Absent means the run recorded no coverage.

mechanism.description: <file>::<symbol> that was disabled for the run.

status.description: The test's outcome with the mechanism disabled. Anything but passed means the test depends on it; error means the pair could not be run.

fails_without.description: Optional; present on dependence records (kind = "dependence"). One entry per mechanism the test was run without.

tests.description: One record per test with its own status. A test_attested assertion names one of these exactly and requires its status to be passed; a skipped test is not evidence. Optional per-test fields bind the record to the test's definition (file, definition_sha256, definition_scope), what it reached (reached), and what it fails without (fails_without).

ci.description: Recorded for a reader; never a trust anchor. Trust comes from the signature.

environment.description: Nominated environment variables and their values at run time; null records that a nominated name was unset. Absent when the producer nominated nothing, which cannot satisfy an assertion's env requirement.

kind.description: Optional. Absent for a test-result record. "dependence" marks a record produced by `mipiti-verify attest-dependence`: each test entry's status is the test's outcome with the mechanism named in its fails_without entry disabled. A dependence record never evidences that a test ran and passed.
